selection: C minimum pooled development log loss; promote only if paired game-bootstrap log-loss upper95<0 versus BOTH B1 and B2, Brier delta<=0.0001 versus both, and pooled development O/E in [0.8,1.25] in EACH FTN group. Otherwise choose B1 or B2 with lowest pooled development log loss; tie prefers B1. Never select using 2025/2026.
support: Rate k/n when 0<k<n; boundary k=0 or k=n uses (k+0.5)/(n+1). Missing FTN group falls back to full training global rate with explicit fallback record; empty full training fails.
scope: Retrospective temporal evaluation, already examined periods; no untouched confirmation or pre-snap prediction. FTN may know the outcome.
